resources.string: This phone is managed by Noahport

This is a company phone. It belongs to Noahport and is managed by Noahport IT using this app. 

What Noahport can see 
• Phone details: model, Android version, security updates 
• Which apps are installed 
• How much mobile data and Wi-Fi each app uses, including data shared through the hotspot 
• Which websites and online services the phone connects to (their names and addresses, not what you read, type or send) 

What Noahport cannot see 
• Your messages, calls, contacts, photos, videos or files 
• Your location 
• What is on your screen, what you type, or your passwords 

What Noahport IT can do 
• Allow or block the hotspot and certain apps 
• Set screen-lock rules 
• Lock or restart the phone, reset its screen lock, or erase it if it is lost or stolen 

Network activity records are kept for 90 days. Only Noahport IT administrators can see this information. It is used to manage company phones, control data costs and keep them secure, as described in Noahport's device-use policy. 

Questions? Contact Noahport IT.
